title: Cartesian higher image raw affine class descent
statement: Let k be a field, I a small cofiltered category, D:I→Over(Spec k) a diagram with qcqs structure maps and affine transitions, c a cone with limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure map, f:X→Spec k qcqs, F an abelian etale sheaf on X, q a natural number and U an affine etale object over c.pt. For every morphism z:Z[U][0]→cartesianDerivedImage(f,c.pt.hom,F[0])[q], there exist i∈I and t:Z[U][0]→D+(π_i inverse-image)(cartesianDerivedImage(f,D(i).hom,F[0]))[q] such that t followed by the shift of the prescribed cartesianDerivedImageMap is z.

proof.text: Obtain H,B,a,lift,e and their equations from the affine complex presentation. Apply EtaleComplexCohomologyPresentation.isColimit. The forgetful functor on abelian groups preserves this filtered colimit, so Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep represents e.inv(z) by x at one stage. The compatibility equation and e.inv_hom_id identify lift(x) followed by the shifted cartesian leg with z.

theorem exists_cartesianHigherImage_raw_affine_factorization
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (U : c.pt.left.Etale) [IsAffine U.left]
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((abelianComparisonFree c.pt.left).obj U) ⟶
        (cartesianDerivedImage f c.pt.hom
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧) :
    ∃ (i : I)
      (t : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((abelianComparisonFree c.pt.left).obj U) ⟶
          ((D+(((c.π.app i).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj
            (cartesianDerivedImage f (D.obj i).hom
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧),
      t ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj i).hom c.pt.hom (c.π.app i).left
          (Over.w (c.π.app i)).symm ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) = z
